title: Can I BEAT Infinite Chess? (vs Pjschess)
summary: The creator plays a best-of-three Infinite Chess match (infinitechess.org, private room, 5+2 time control) against similarly-rated YouTuber PJs Chess. He is Black in game 1. The board is infinite; he zooms out, uses arrows, and tries to 'overwhelm the opponent with how big the board is' by sending rooks and queen far out and giving long-range checks from behind. He wins game 1, and the match comes down to time scrambles (5 seconds, 20 seconds left) before he wins.
rules: Board is infinite in all directions (no edges); pieces can move any distance off the starting area.
Time control 5+2 (stated '52', interpreted as 5 min + 2 s increment).

board.shape_notes: Infinite board with zoom/pan; arrows drawable.
